# Edward Omondi

> Full-Stack Software Engineer and Solutions Architect based in Nairobi, Kenya, with 5+ years of experience across the Java/Spring, Vue/Nuxt, and Angular ecosystems. Co-founder and architect of two live SaaS platforms. Background in Mechatronics Engineering bridging hardware and software (IoT, Raspberry Pi, RFID).

Contact: ewomondi@gmail.com · https://github.com/EdwardOmondi · https://linkedin.com/in/edward-omondi-otieno/

## Core Skills

- Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Jakarta EE, FastAPI
- Frontend: Vue.js, Nuxt, Angular
- Mobile: Flutter, Kotlin (Jetpack Compose), Swift (SwiftUI)
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Firebase
- Security: OAuth 2.0, Keycloak, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
- Messaging / Event-Driven Architecture: Apache Artemis, JMS
- DevOps / Cloud: Linux, AWS, DigitalOcean, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, CI/CD
- IoT / Embedded: Raspberry Pi, microcontrollers, RFID

## Experience

## Selected Projects

- Cardly: Gift card & loyalty SaaS (Nuxt, Spring Boot, Keycloak, Stripe, M-Pesa) - https://cardly.gift
- Aims: Smart-lock property management with a Raspberry Pi IoT controller (Angular, Spring Boot) - https://aims.homes
- Kwaru: Stock, POS and finance for hardware & timber businesses (Spring Boot, Nuxt, Keycloak) - https://kwaru.finsoma.com
- Ahadi: Multi-tenant pledge & fundraising platform with M-Pesa and SMS (Spring Boot, Nuxt) - https://ahadi.finsoma.com
- EBMM (the dtic, South Africa): Non-tariff barrier reporting & case management, four-portal web app plus Android (Nuxt, Jakarta EE, Kotlin) - via Technovation
- Sarit Belong (Sarit Centre): Mall loyalty, e-purse, vouchers and parking platform with four web portals (Nuxt, Jakarta EE) - via Technovation
- SMSTele / Ujumbe SMS (Mobi4Tech): Carrier-grade bulk SMS platform with developer sandbox (Jakarta EE, Artemis, Nuxt) - via Technovation
- ZFDA (Zanzibar Food & Drug Authority): Regulatory licensing portal and MIS (Jakarta EE, JSF/PrimeFaces, Keycloak) - via Technovation
- BiasharaLink & The Deal House: Pan-African B2B trade network with real-time deal rooms, 5 languages (Nuxt, Jakarta EE) - via Technovation
- Skycrash: White-labelled real-time multiplayer crash game (Angular, WebSocket/STOMP) - via Technovation
- Chanuka MFL: Micro-lending core with double-entry ledger and bank disbursement (Jakarta EE, Nuxt) - in progress, via Technovation
- Salon Booking & POS: Booking, deposits and POS SaaS for kids' salons (Spring Boot, Paystack) - in progress
- Finsoma: School-fees financing with school/bank/insurer approval workflow (Spring Boot, Nuxt) - https://school.finsoma.com
- Digital SMS: Bulk SMS SaaS from Excel uploads (Spring Boot, Nuxt, Twilio, Stripe) - http://digitalsms.investor1properties.com
- The Offtaker: Livestock market strategy simulation game (Nuxt) - https://kpmdgame.com
- Herdwise: Livestock farmer data collection (Angular, Firebase) - https://herdwiseapp.web.app
- Built Art Studios: Portfolio & lead-generation site for an architecture studio (Nuxt) - https://builtartstudios.com
- Autosterile (EA): Medical device manufacturer website & catalogue (Nuxt) - https://www.autosterileea.biz
